explore-deviation.title: Set the deviation
explore-deviation.prompt: Set your deviation to match the repeater's 5 kHz.
hints: Turn the deviation up to 5 kHz.
explore-deviation.success: At 5 kHz your audio level is normal, and the signal is about 16 kHz wide. Go past it and you distort.

explore-squelch.title: The rushing noise
explore-squelch.prompt: Stop the receiver roaring when no one is talking.
explore-squelch.success: Squelch mutes the audio until a signal arrives. The roar came from the huge gain ahead of the discriminator.
